description: Read public Reddit data with Desearch. Set action and that action's arguments. search (query; optional sort, timeframe, cursor): posts across all subreddits that match a keyword. subreddit (name): a subreddit's description, rules, and weekly activity; the name is case-sensitive ('AskReddit', not 'askreddit'). subreddit_posts (name; optional sort, timeframe, cursor): its posts. post (id): one post by ID or URL, without comments. comments (post_id; optional cursor): a post's comments as a tree, with the replies Reddit loaded alongside them. A post id from search or subreddit_posts can be passed to post or comments. subreddit and post return the item itself. List actions return { results, next_cursor, next }. For the next page, call again with the same action and target and cursor set to next_cursor, unchanged; next_cursor is null on the last page. A cursor lasts 24 hours.

cursor.description: next_cursor from the previous page of the same action and target, sent back unchanged. Omit it for the first page.

id.description: post: Reddit post ID (example: '1q6pxwn', with or without t3_) or its full URL.

name.description: subreddit, subreddit_posts: subreddit name, case-sensitive, example: 'AskReddit'. A leading r/ is removed.

post_id.description: comments: Reddit post ID (with or without t3_) or its full URL.

timeframe.description: search: only posts from this window. subreddit_posts: the window for sort 'top' (ignored with another sort; without a sort it means top).

name: reddit
title: Reddit
